verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is Skills: modular instruction sets with detailed guidance that Cline loads only when relevant to a request. A developer could put conventions in a Skill, but the pack never documents a persistent, always-applied project instructions or rules file for coding standards. Missing for 10: a documented project-level instructions/rules file that is always applied, its file location and format, evidence that it scopes conventions to a project, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
